title: Cup Disc Ratio and Visual Fields

steps.tx: **Cup-disc ratio** expresses cup diameter as fraction of disc diameter, vertical ratio more glaucoma sensitive than horizontal because cup enlarges vertically first. Population normal centre near three tenths with wide physiological range by disc size. Ratio therefore screens suspicion, never diagnoses alone without rim and field correlation.
steps.say: Vertical ratio together gives screening suspicion in disc assessment at glaucoma clinics for adults with large cups. Size range gives diagnosis caution additionally. Correlation gives label requirement.

steps.tx: **Asymmetry** of cup ratio between eyes beyond about two tenths in similar sized discs suspects glaucoma because physiological cups mirror closely. Asymmetric ratio therefore triggers full workup even where each ratio individually within population range. Fellow eye comparison is free screening information at every disc examination.
steps.say: Fellow comparison together gives asymmetry trigger in disc screening at primary eye care for adults with borderline ratios. Mirror expectation gives suspicion logic additionally. Workup gives completion need.
